findings.finding: The I01 wire has a third pinned input that the contract neither registers nor names as unregistered: docs/alpha-2/POLICY_OBSERVATION_READINESS.md (sha256 65778040919c5eb7335f2c104d983ca920b877b1b123f961556a6bcae36d232c). architecture/policy-observation-amendment.json at 29c84b36 names it as channel.guidePath and pins it in inputFiles next to CS and PV. findings.finding: The record does not say what else the replay needs, though v8's README did ('Every other input of v4's check_vectors is already registered'). Request-case replay needs no other harness-onion file. The schema's three $refs are all internal (#/$defs/binding|request|observation) and $schema is the standard 2020-12 meta-schema. The request's bindingDigest e10d89fd... equals sha256 of the canonical vectors' own binding. runNonce comes from binding.scope, and positive.previous is null, so the request opens the chain. But the vendored vectors.json also holds 5 binding and 17 observation negatives, plus a positive whose binding.profileDigest fc569e17... is the sha256 of the canonical positive of architecture/proxy-contract-inputs/vectors.json. That file is not registered in v8 or v9, and the harness-onion oracle (validate_messages) reads it for the profile-digest, scope, policy-digest and quota checks.
findings.requiredChange: Add a note and a README sentence stating that U7's request-case replay needs only CS and PV (internal $refs only; the binding digest is over the vectors' own binding). Also state that replaying the binding or observation cases would need architecture/proxy-contract-inputs/vectors.json, which is unregistered, so HE-004-I01 may not vendor or replay those cases until a later record registers it.
